name: ferrata_monitor_module
description: Ferrata (prototype, unaudited, not for production): the watchers' monitor as a module: follows a Ferrata vault, checks every candidate checkpoint against its own node views and cancels a wrong one in time, pauses checkpoints, alerts on and revokes a wrong finalised one, audits rule (B)'s published attestations, as a loop under Logos Core or for a given number of polls, and offline verdicts
